app.title: subtext
app.tagline: Animated captions for your clips. Local, offline, free.
drop.headline: Drop a video here
drop.hint: MP4, MOV and anything else your ffmpeg reads
drop.active: Let go to load the clip
style.heading: Caption style
style.bold-center.desc: Three words, dead centre, active word pops
style.karaoke-line.desc: The line fills up as it is spoken
lang.heading: Spoken language
result.heading: Your captioned video is ready
setup.ffmpeg.heading: ffmpeg is missing
setup.ffmpeg.body: subtext uses ffmpeg to read and render video. Install it once, then restart subtext.
setup.model.heading: One speech model needed
setup.model.body: Models are not bundled with the app. Pick one, it downloads once and then stays on your machine.
setup.model.base: Base, fastest, good enough for clear speech
error.heading: That did not work
error.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg was not found on this machine.
error.ffmpeg_failed: ffmpeg could not process this file.
error.file_not_found: That file is no longer where it was.
error.model_missing: No speech model is installed yet.
error.transcription_failed: The speech model could not transcribe this audio.
error.unknown_duration: The length of this video could not be read.
error.io_error: A file could not be read or written.
error.download_failed: The model download did not finish.
error.unknown_style: That caption style does not exist.
error.asr_disabled: This build has speech recognition switched off.
error.busy: One video is already being processed.
